description: Ask each model key the workspace's agents run on whether its account can pay, with a billed request: a one-token answer for an OpenAI or Anthropic key (about a thousandth of a cent), and for an OpenRouter key the model and output limit of each default agent (less than a hundredth of a cent), which OpenRouter refuses when the balance cannot pay for the full output. willFail is true when the key the default agents use cannot pay: a mission started now stops at its first request. warning is the sentence to show the person.
name: check_model_credit
title: Check model key credit
